capacity.title: Capacity & usage
capacity.subtitle: Included capacity on your plan and how much you've used. Live figures sync from Openship Cloud.

topupsComingSoon: One-time credit top-ups are coming soon — you'll be able to add credits on top of your monthly allowance here.

notConnected.title: Connect to Openship Cloud to manage billing
notConnected.description: Your local instance isn't connected to Openship Cloud yet. Connect to view subscription state, usage, invoices, and top-ups.

sessionExpired.title: Your Openship Cloud session expired
sessionExpired.description: You're still linked, but the session token Openship Cloud issued is no longer valid. Reconnect to refresh it — no need to disconnect first.

unreachable.title: Couldn't reach Openship Cloud billing
unreachable.description: Your cloud session may have expired or the cloud is temporarily unavailable. Try again, or reconnect from Settings → Cloud.

notEnabled.title: Cloud purchases are not available yet
notEnabled.description: Openship has not enabled subscriptions and credit purchases yet. Please try again later.

notConfigured.title: Cloud billing setup is incomplete
notConfigured.description: Openship needs to finish setting up billing. Please contact Openship support.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to billing
forbidden.description: Ask your organization owner to grant you billing access.

signInRequired.title: Sign in to view billing
signInRequired.description: Your session could not be verified. Sign in again to continue.

loadFailed.title: Couldn't load billing
loadFailed.description: Billing is temporarily unavailable. Try again. If the problem continues, contact Openship support.

plansRoute.changeViaSupport: Contact support to change or cancel your current subscription.
plansRoute.billingUnavailable: Purchases are not available for this account yet.
plansRoute.replacementNotice: Changing your plan or billing interval starts a new cycle at the full selected price after payment. There is no automatic proration.

topups.allowanceEquivalent: of one billing cycle’s included usage

checkout.checking: Refreshing your Cloud plan and balance. Payment may take a moment to process.
checkout.pending: Your payment may still be processing. Refresh this page to check your plan and balance. Contact support if a completed payment is missing.

subscription.endsOn: Renewal stopped. Your subscription ends on {date}.
subscription.endsAtPeriodEnd: Renewal stopped. Your subscription ends at the end of the paid period.

subscription.cancelNotice: Renewal will stop at the end of your paid period. Your subscription stays in place until then.
subscription.error: Unable to update your subscription. Please retry.

deployGate.title: Choose a plan to deploy
deployGate.description: A paid Cloud plan is required to create projects, build your code and run apps.
deployGate.preserved: Your project settings stay here. Checkout opens in a new tab; return here after activating your plan to continue.
deployGate.loadError: Couldn't load your Cloud plan. Try again.
deployGate.ownerRequired: Ask your workspace owner to choose or manage your Cloud plan.
deployGate.ready: Your Cloud plan is updated. Close this window and try again.
deployGate.pending: Your plan hasn't changed yet. Finish checkout, then check again.
deployGate.creditsDescription: Add more usage or choose a larger plan to continue. Extra usage does not raise project, build time or service limits.
deployGate.paymentDescription: Update your payment or subscription details to continue deploying.
deployGate.pausedDescription: Cloud deployment is paused for this workspace. Contact support to restore access.
deployGate.upgradeDescription: Choose a plan with enough capacity, or adjust your project and try again.
deployGate.checkoutOpened: Checkout is ready in a separate tab. If it did not open, use the link below.

reasons.static-only: Your plan does not include this type of app. Choose a plan that supports it to deploy.
reasons.build-minutes-exhausted: You've reached your monthly build time limit. Choose a larger plan, or wait for your build allowance to reset.
reasons.free-subdomain-limit: You've used all the Cloud subdomains in your plan. Choose a larger plan, or remove an unused subdomain.
reasons.resource-tier: This project needs more CPU or memory than your plan allows. Choose a larger plan, or lower the resources in your project settings.
reasons.running-services: You've reached your running service limit. Choose a larger plan, or stop a service you no longer need.
reasons.project-limit: You've reached your project limit. Choose a larger plan, or delete a project you no longer need.

resourcesGuide.title: How Cloud usage works
resourcesGuide.creditsHint: Builds and running apps use credits for CPU, memory, disk activity and data transfer. Larger workloads use credits faster.
resourcesGuide.buildHint: Time spent building your code. A 5-minute build uses 5 build minutes from your monthly allowance.
resourcesGuide.appsHint: Apps, databases and workers running at the same time. Each running Compose service counts toward this limit.
resourcesGuide.machineHint: The largest CPU and memory size available for one service. This is a limit, not a shared balance.
resourcesGuide.projectsHint: Projects saved in your workspace, including drafts.
resourcesGuide.routesHint: Public Cloud addresses for your apps.
resourcesGuide.setupHint: Choose a Cloud plan to create projects, build your code and run apps.
resourcesGuide.limitsHint: Projects, running services and monthly build time in your plan.
resourcesGuide.balanceRule: Apps pause when the usage allowance runs out. Add more usage to continue, or upgrade for higher resource limits.
resourcesGuide.cpuHint: Processing used over time. 1 vCPU running for 1 hour is 1 vCPU-hour.
resourcesGuide.memoryHint: Memory used over time. 1 GB for 1 hour is 1 GB-hour.
resourcesGuide.diskHint: Data read and written by your apps. This is disk activity, not stored disk size.
resourcesGuide.networkHint: Data sent and received by your apps.
resourcesGuide.selectedRange: Credits used in this date range
resourcesGuide.usageHint: Actual CPU, memory, disk activity and data transfer for the selected dates.
resourcesGuide.invalidRange: Choose an end date on or after the start date.
resourcesGuide.usageSummary: Builds and running apps share a usage allowance. Larger machines and longer running times use more.

onboarding.workspaceDescription: Choose a Cloud plan to create projects, build your code and run your apps. No projects or compute are included before subscribing.
onboarding.savedCreditsHint: Your prepaid usage stays in this workspace. Choose a plan to use it for Cloud deployments.
onboarding.offerDescription: A home for your projects, with build time and resources for your apps.
onboarding.checkoutNote: Review your payment details before subscribing.
onboarding.stepPlanHint: Choose the projects, services and build time you need.
onboarding.stepCheckoutHint: Your Cloud plan activates after payment.
onboarding.stepDeployHint: Create your project and press Deploy.
onboarding.usageDescription: Deploy on a paid plan to see your build and app usage here.
onboarding.paymentDescription: Add a payment method during checkout. You can manage it here after your first purchase.
onboarding.invoicesDescription: Your invoices and receipts appear after your first payment.
onboarding.topupsDescription: Your plan includes usage for builds and apps. Add more after your subscription is active.
onboarding.compareTitle: Find the right plan for your projects
onboarding.compareDescription: Compare projects, services, build time, and the CPU and memory available to each app.
onboarding.savedProjects: Saved projects in this workspace: {count}. Subscribe to add more.

resourceOverview.overviewHint: Your workspace’s usage, remaining allowance and plan limits.
resourceOverview.computeHint: CPU, memory, disk activity and app transfer share one allowance. Usage includes builds and running apps.
resourceOverview.cpuHint: 1 vCPU-h is one CPU core used for one hour. This measures work done, not app uptime.
resourceOverview.memoryHint: 1 GB-h is 1 GB of memory allocated for one hour.
resourceOverview.diskHint: Data read from and written to app disks. This is disk activity, not stored disk size.
resourceOverview.transferHint: Inbound and outbound data from your compute workloads. Edge delivery is shown separately.
resourceOverview.bandwidthHint: Incoming and outgoing traffic across your workspace’s edge routes. This monthly allowance is separate from compute. Routes pause at the limit until reset or upgrade.
resourceOverview.requestsHint: HTTP requests served through your workspace’s edge routes. These are visitor requests, not billing records or API calls.
resourceOverview.partialError: Some usage could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
